verdict.rationale: Figma's MCP server explicitly supports writing to the canvas (create/modify native content), plus Plugin API documented with read/write access to create and modify file contents, and this is corroborated by a live runtime probe showing the hosted MCP endpoint is live and speaking MCP OAuth. missing for 10: independent hands-on community confirmation of write-capable MCP/plugin usage (community evidence only discusses read/export workflows, not agent-driven writes), and no independent third-party audit of the write API's reliability.
